ideas.title: The Impact of Federal Funding Freezes on Public Transit
ideas.description: Investigate the effects of federal funding freezes on public transit systems across the US, including Chicago.
ideas.angle: Analyzing the consequences of funding freezes on public services
questions: How do funding freezes affect public transit?
What are the political implications of such freezes?
ideas.insight: This story could explore the broader implications of federal funding freezes on public services and infrastructure.

ideas.title: The Prevalence of Tax Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Examine the prevalence and detection of tax fraud in Minnesota, including the case of the Minnesota man accused of underreporting income.
questions: How common is tax fraud in Minnesota?
What methods are used to detect tax fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could delve into the specifics of tax fraud cases in Minnesota and the efforts to combat them.
